capabilities: Browse and query a Zotero library inside Obsidian
Read and annotate paper PDFs beside the draft
Create template-based literature notes from Zotero items
Insert citations and see a live reference list in a citation style
Export a draft to Word with a formatted bibliography
extras: Requires an Obsidian installer of 1.13.4+ (in-app updates are not enough) or the plugin fails to load. v1 to v2 migration has breaking changes for literature notes and templates. The README discloses direct reads of the Zotero database, a localhost notification server, and use of macOS cp -c for zero-copy file clones, and advises backing up vault and Zotero data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to work with a Zotero library: browsing items, reading and annotating PDFs, or producing formatted citations and bibliographies.

relations.evidence: ZotLit lets Zotero manage your papers, PDFs, and annotations, and keeps Obsidian for your thinking and writing.

summary: Zotero integration that lets you browse your library, read and annotate PDFs, write literature notes, cite as you type, and export to Word.
